title: Trace stroke order before you write freely
summary: Follow the animated stroke order first, then write by hand on paper, never on screen only.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Handwriting is a motor skill, and motor skills need a pen on paper. Watch a character stroke by stroke first so you know which line comes before which, then write the whole character from memory several times. Stroke order is not etiquette; it decides how a character stays readable when written fast, and it is how you get the top-left-to-bottom-right rhythm that makes your handwriting legible to someone else. Pick five characters per session and stop when the fifth one looks wrong, rather than filling a page from a bad model.
